_comment: Upstream third-party projects built with blade, for regression. We DO NOT re-host their source: each entry pins an upstream repo + commit; regress.ps1 clones it at that SHA and overlays our BUILD/BLADE_ROOT files (in overlays/<name>/) on top, then runs blade. Bump 'sha' to track a newer upstream.

samples.name: putty
samples.needs: perl on PATH (prebuild runs licence.pl to generate licence.h)
